## Approved plan task B3

- **Functional scope/files:** review running BO against A0's matrix; no feature redesign.
- **Tests/branches:** run existing relevant browser journeys and inspect send/stream/final/error, agent/filter use, new/resume chat, history, feedback, previews and trace information. Record screenshots or observations where useful.
- **Mocking:** existing approved deterministic browser fixture environment.
- **Documentation:** Beadwork records exact human UX/behavior approval and any corrections. New/substantially rewritten E2E authoring stays blocked until this approval.
- **Action reuse:** not applicable; validation/approval only.
- **Done:** user explicitly confirms BO parity; any deviation is fixed and revalidated before B4.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.6 (B2).
Blocks zaq-pkd.8 (B4).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.
Keep open until the user explicitly approves the implemented BO experience; plan approval is not UX approval.
